text:
morgan: kicking off a config-only canary for routing + batching (tinybatch) — will do 5% -> 20% over 30m if gating looks good. changes: reduce `max_batch_size` 64->32, add `smallburst_limit=10` per-tenant, route weight to cheap-quantized variant = 0.2. no model version changes. deploy-bot should run metric gates.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: env=prod, type=config-only, canary=5%, id=cfg-20260321-01, initiated by morgan

lee: oncall — i'll watch latency, errors, and tenant fairness. ping me when you hit 20%

morgan: noted — enabling a tiny KV prefix caching tweak as part of this; shouldn't affect outputs but might change latency profile slightly

sanjay: lgtm. gating thresholds: halt on 99p latency increase > 30ms or absolute 99p > 220ms, or 5xx spike > 1.5x baseline for 5m

deploy-bot: Gating: collecting metrics, sending alerts to #eng-oncall. dashboards: thinbatch canary overview

tara: i'll watch batch size histograms and token throughput. quick q: confirm model is pinned?

morgan: yes pinned to v20260315 — purely config-only

ops-oncall: canary deployed to 5%. seeing a small tail bump +30ms at t+4m. holding at 5% for 15m to observe (no 5xx increase yet)

morgan: ack. rollback plan: immediate unpin if 99p latency > 250ms or error rate >2% sustained for 5m

sanjay: also please enable sampling of throttle events (1%) so we can see tenant-level effects

deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 20% (manual). gating summary: latency +12ms, 5xx unchanged, token cost -3%. Proceed?

lee: :+1: proceed, i'll keep an eye on alerts and tenant queues

tara: spotted some tenants with increased queueing on concurrent spikes — lowering `smallburst_limit` to 8 in-place for heavy tenants; starting manual exception list for T-42 and T-77

morgan: patched config to set `smallburst_limit=8` for T-42,T-77 and rolling that exception now

ops-oncall: regression observed: T-42 p99 -> 270ms for ~3m after exception. rolled back exception for T-42 and rebalanced route weights. p99 back down to ~190ms

sanjay: good rollback. recommendation: freeze rollout and collect 30m of post-change metrics. add a release note outlining cost vs tail latency tradeoff

morgan: agree. pausing rollout. i'll open the release note PR and tag product + support for comms

deploy-bot: Deploy paused at 20% per request from morgan. canary_id=cfg-20260321-01, status=paused

morgan: @ops-oncall @sanjay @tara thanks — handing off 30m metric watch to afternoon oncall @lee. next steps: release-note PR + clearer revert/runbook in docs

lee: on it. creating quick dashboard link: https://grafana/redwood/d/abcd/canary-thinbatch?orgId=1

deploy-bot: To resume: `/deploy resume cfg-20260321-01`. To abort: `/deploy abort cfg-20260321-01`.

morgan: final note for release notes: "Reduced max_batch_size and introduced per-tenant smallburst limiter to reduce average cost per token; observed ~3% cost savings in canary with a small increase in tail latency for certain heavy-tenant access patterns. Paused rollout for additional analysis and tenant-specific adjustments."
